title: 2026 Guideline for Adult Stroke Rehabilitation and Recovery: A Guideline From the American Heart Association and American Stroke Association

recommendations.text: AHA/ASA published this guideline online on 27 August 2026 (PMID 42657476; DOI 10.1161/STR.0000000000000536). Its abstract states that it replaces the 2016 adult stroke rehabilitation guideline and updates assessment and treatment of medical comorbidities, fracture risk, fall prevention, technology-enabled rehabilitation, caregiver support, participation, and return to work and driving. The complete graded recommendation tables were not recovered in the 30 September 2026 review. This is a source record only; no recommendation-level extraction or clinical-currentness claim is made.
